transcript: I'm not sure that there were any important values or approaches that were absent from all of the utopias. And I mean, obviously, there are a society needs rules to function or something like rules um but i think that was present in all of them um in different ways and i think what would matter most in my vision of society would just be um kind of caring for the human race and i think I think protecting resources and not necessarily in a socialist aspect, but just making sure that people are cared for and the society is built to foster that.
